sources.entry: Capso - Open-source screenshot and screen recording tool with annotations, OCR, and webcam overlays. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/lzhgus/Capso) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Capso is an open-source, native Swift/SwiftUI screenshot and screen recording app for macOS that aims to be a free alternative to CleanShot X.
summary.what_it_does: Capso provides area, fullscreen, window, scrolling, timer, OCR, and recording capture from a floating all-in-one HUD. Screenshots can be annotated (arrows, shapes, text, pixelation, counters), beautified with background, padding, corners and shadow, and pinned to the screen. Screen recording supports MP4 and GIF output with optional webcam picture-in-picture, system audio and microphone, and a recording editor with trim, zoom, and cursor smoothing. It also includes OCR text extraction, capture-and-translate, a persistent history library, and optional upload to the user's own Cloudflare R2 bucket. The codebase is split into 12 reusable Swift packages (such as CaptureKit and AnnotationKit) that can be embedded separately.
use_cases: Take annotated screenshots on a Mac
Record screen video or GIF with webcam overlay
Scrolling capture of long web pages
Extract text from a screen area with OCR
Translate on-screen text from a capture
Share screenshots via own Cloudflare R2 storage
how_to_run: open Capso.xcodeproj  (then build and run in Xcode with Cmd+R)
notable: Native Swift 6 app rather than Electron or Tauri
Modular design with 12 reusable SPM packages such as CaptureKit and AnnotationKit
Webcam PiP with four shapes and camera presentation mode
Bring-your-own Cloudflare R2 storage with no hosted service
Signed and notarized DMG plus Homebrew cask install
caveats: Requires macOS 15.0 or later and Xcode 16+ to build from source
Business Source License 1.1 rather than a standard open-source license until it converts to Apache 2.0 after three years per release
Screen recording, camera, and microphone permissions must be granted
Additional cloud providers (Backblaze B2, AWS S3, generic S3) are planned but not yet supported
